plugin.name: ALMA
plugin.description: Simulation of emotions, mood based on appraisal and personality values, via a remote ALMA server over WebSocket

required.name: ws_url
required.description: ALMA server WebSocket URL, e.g. wss://alma.scaai.dfki.dev/ws for the hosted server, or ws://localhost:8080/ws for a local ALMA2025 instance

required.name: project
required.description: Path to the ALMA project XML (AffectComputation + AffectDefinition), relative to this VSM project

optional.name: keycloak_token_url
optional.description: Keycloak token endpoint for the client-credentials grant, e.g. https://keycloak.scaai.dfki.dev/realms/vsm/protocol/openid-connect/token. Leave blank together with client_id/client_secret to skip authentication entirely (e.g. a local ALMA2025 run without OIDC_ISSUER_URL configured)

optional.name: client_id
optional.description: Keycloak service-account client id used to authenticate to the ALMA server. Leave blank to skip authentication (local/unauthenticated ALMA2025)

optional.name: client_secret
optional.description: Keycloak service-account client secret. Leave blank to skip authentication (local/unauthenticated ALMA2025)

optional.name: connectedVar
optional.description: SceneFlow variable set to true once connected to (and authenticated/initialized with) the ALMA server, and back to false on disconnect or connect failure

commands.name: reset
commands.summary: Reset ALMA state (re-uploads the project, clearing character state)
